source_manifest.frame: common map ENU (x east, y north, z up); yaw 0 relative to map x
source_manifest.synchronization: one shared clock and start trigger; all UAVs use the same progress
source_manifest.interface: ROS 1 MAVROS setpoint_raw/local; ROS fields ENU, MAVROS converts to MAVLink LOCAL_NED once
source_manifest.phase_scope: already airborne suspended transport only; actual takeoff/landing are separate procedures
hardware_requirements: measured masses, rigging and thrust margin
actual attachment positions and rope properties
surveyed map-to-each-PX4-origin transforms and yaw offsets
validated localization noise/delay and clock synchronization
hardware-specific tracking and coordinated failsafe validation

frames.description: Example only. Replace with measured origins and yaw before hardware execution.

coordinate_frame: per-UAV local ENU for ROS/MAVROS; not preconverted NED
note: Frame calibration alone does not validate carrying capacity, localization, tracking, or coordinated failsafes
